strategy.entry_product: shampoo, body-wash and home-care refill pouches
strategy.differentiation_angle: leak-resistant refill structures, spout compatibility and stable repeat printing for multiple private-label lines
strategy.first_contact_goal: confirm which liquid lines use refill pouches and the annual sourcing plan
questions: Which product lines currently use refill or spouted pouches?
What are the fill volume, formula compatibility, closure and annual volume?
risks: The public site does not identify the current pouch supplier or current flexible-format share.

strategy.entry_product: seasoning powder bags, sauce pouches and coconut-chip stand-up pouches
strategy.differentiation_angle: separate moisture, aroma, oil and liquid-seal structures by product family instead of one generic proposal
strategy.first_contact_goal: identify one recurring export pack with stable annual volume for a structure review
questions: Which seasoning, sauce or snack line has the largest recurring flexible-pack volume?
What are the pack size, filling process, shelf-life and annual volume?
risks: Exact structures, packing lines and incumbent suppliers are not stated on the public product pages.

strategy.entry_product: 250g tea pouches and tea-bag outer roll film
strategy.differentiation_angle: aroma and moisture protection matched to the existing packing machine and regional distribution cycle
strategy.first_contact_goal: confirm the 250g pouch and tea-bag overwrap specifications and annual consumption
questions: What are the current laminate, dimensions and zipper or seal format for the 250g pack?
Which machine, roll width, repeat length and annual volume apply to tea-bag overwrap?
risks: The current supplier and laminate structure are not established by the public site.

strategy.entry_product: liquid-detergent refill pouches, spouted pouches and detergent-powder bags
strategy.differentiation_angle: formula compatibility and leak control for liquids, plus powder sealing and moisture control for dry detergent
strategy.first_contact_goal: select one liquid and one powder line for a packaging structure and filling-process review
questions: Which liquid products use refill pouches and what are the fill volume, formula and closure?
What are the powder pack size, sealing conditions and annual bag volume?
risks: The public contact page confirms manufacturing sites but not current flexible-pack specifications or suppliers.

strategy.entry_product: high-barrier loose-leaf tea pouches and automated tea overwrap roll film
strategy.differentiation_angle: aroma retention, moisture barrier and machine-compatible roll control for full-cycle tea production
strategy.first_contact_goal: confirm the highest-volume pouch or overwrap line and obtain its machine and laminate specification
questions: Which loose-leaf or tea-bag format has the largest annual flexible-pack consumption?
What are the laminate, roll width, repeat length, machine speed and annual volume?
risks: Public production information does not name the incumbent supplier or exact laminate.
